UserCloudProfile.title: UserCloudProfile
UserCloudProfile.description: Private cloud identity profile for an authenticated email owner in RM.POS GC.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

email.description: Verified email address of the cloud account owner.

displayName.description: Display name of the cloud account owner.

photoURL.description: Optional profile avatar URL from the identity provider.

activeAccountId.description: Last active store account ID for cross-device convenience.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

CloudAccount.title: CloudAccount
CloudAccount.description: Independent licensed store tenant owned by a verified email user and synced across devices.

accountId.description: Unique tenant account identifier matching the document ID.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the store owner.

ownerEmail.description: Verified email address linked to this store account.

ownerPhone.description: Optional phone number of the store owner.

ownerName.description: Full name of the store owner.

licenseNumber.description: Unique RM.POS GC license key bound to this store account.

activationCodeHash.description: PBKDF2-SHA256 hash of the license activation code.

activationCodeSalt.description: Cryptographic salt for the activation code hash.

licenseStatus.description: Current license state; revoked is a terminal state for non-admins.

activatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the license was activated.

syncRevision.description: Monotonically increasing revision counter for multi-device cloud sync.

lastSyncedDeviceId.description: Identifier of the device that pushed the latest sync revision.

lastSyncedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest cloud sync.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud account was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the cloud account metadata was last modified.

CloudTableChunk.title: CloudTableChunk
CloudTableChunk.description: Bounded native-map chunk of a synced POS database table belonging to a specific store account.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning account.

tableName.description: Name of the POS database table stored in this chunk.

chunkIndex.description: Zero-based index of this chunk within the table.

totalChunks.description: Total number of chunks for this table at this sync revision.

itemCount.description: Number of records stored in the items array.

items.description: Bounded array (max 100) of native Firestore map objects representing table rows.

syncRevision.description: Sync revision matching the parent CloudAccount.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this chunk document was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when this chunk document was last updated.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

/users/{userId}.description: Private email-linked cloud profile for each authenticated user (PII isolated).

/users/{userId}/accounts/{accountId}.description: Independent licensed store accounts owned by a verified cloud email user.

/users/{userId}/accounts/{accountId}/tab.description: Bounded native-map table chunks synced across devices for a store account.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Trusted administrator directory for RBAC verification.
